name: WebSocket Tester
description: Connect to a WebSocket endpoint straight from the browser and inspect handshake timing, subprotocol and messages.

hints.headers: Browsers **cannot** set custom headers, use a custom TLS certificate or choose a source port.
hints.origin: Cross-origin connections follow the browser same-origin policy, not this server's configuration.

faq.q: Why does traffic bypass the backend?
faq.a: The page uses the native browser `WebSocket` API, so the server is not involved in the handshake.

faq.q: Are connections counted in the statistics?
faq.a: Message content is never recorded; only the fact that the tool was opened is counted.
When this site is served over HTTPS the browser blocks mixed content, so use `wss://`.
